surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the in situ growth of ZnAl-layered double hydroxide (ZnAl-LDH) on an Al2O3-coated biotemplate, followed by calcination to form a mixed metal oxide (MMO) framework. The ALD process deposits Al2O3 on the biotemplate, preserving its structure and replacing organic material with inorganic material. The ZnAl-LDH film inherits the surface structure of the biotemplate, and upon calcination, it transforms into the MMO framework through phase transformation and decomposition of the biotemplate.
